hero.heading: We grow careers
hero.description: GreenRoot is where agriculture students meet the world. We open doors to international internships so tomorrow's agri leaders can learn in the field, not just from textbooks.

highlightStat.label: students guided into global agri careers

story.heading: Grown from a gap. Guided by a greener future.
story.description: The best agriculture careers aren't built in isolation — they're cultivated across borders, mentors, and seasons of real practice. Here's how GreenRoot took root.

chapters.title: The seed
chapters.label: Why we began
chapters.body: Agriculture students were ready to grow — but the path to real, international experience felt distant, confusing, and out of reach. GreenRoot began as a simple belief: opportunity should travel as freely as ambition.

chapters.title: The roots
chapters.label: How we work
chapters.body: We carefully curate internships with farms and agri organizations worldwide — pairing students with mentors, clear expectations, and hands-on learning that turns classroom knowledge into field confidence.

chapters.title: The canopy
chapters.label: What we promise
chapters.body: Every placement is built on transparency and trust. No guesswork, no empty listings — just meaningful experience that helps the next generation of agri-professionals stand taller in a changing world.

pillars.heading: Mission, vision & promise — in one breath.
pillars.description: Three commitments that shape every internship we share.

items.title: Mission
items.text: Open trusted global internships so agriculture students can learn, innovate, and grow into confident professionals.

items.title: Vision
items.text: Become the platform students and industry leaders trust most to connect talent with worldwide agri opportunity.

items.title: Promise
items.text: Curate every internship for quality and clarity — so every student walks into real experience, not uncertainty.

team.heading: Hands that plant. Minds that guide.
team.description: Founders, team leads, and advisors who blend agronomy, education, and operations — so every student journey feels personal and possible.

goals.heading: Where we're growing next
goals.description: Our north star is simple: make global agricultural learning accessible, trustworthy, and transformative — for every student willing to grow.

items.title: Wider horizons
items.text: Open internship pathways in more countries each year.

items.title: Deeper partnerships
items.text: Grow with leading farms and agricultural organizations.

items.title: Ready for the field
items.text: Help students leave with practical, career-ready skills.

items.title: Grow responsibly
items.text: Champion sustainable and innovative farming practices.
